notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Walk the Aeons and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Walk the Aeons and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Walk the Aeons and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Walk the Aeons's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
